items.message: killswitch_engaged() reads an environment variable that any subprocess or os.environ mutation can set, and a cancelled branch silently becomes BLOCKED/killswitch rather than propagating the cancellation.
Spend reservation fields are plain floats/ints on a shared mutable dataclass with no locking; the atomicity guarantee rests entirely on asyncio's cooperative scheduling.
